# Changelog

## 0.1.3

- Initial modern Fortran/FPM translation.
- Added all GM, GMX, GM2M, DAGM, DAGMX, and DAGM2M numerical variants.
- Added MEM, MEM-X, MEM-MIDAS, and MEM-MIDAS-X.
- Added Normal and Student-t likelihoods, Beta and Almon MIDAS weights.
- Added `maxLik`-based estimation, robust covariance, forecasts, tests, and examples.
